title: Nested Dictionary Key Query
statement: Given a single-line JSON string representing nested objects and a dot-separated query path (e.g. user.address.city), retrieve the value at that path. If any key in the path does not exist, print UNDEFINED.
input_format: Line 1: A JSON string. Line 2: The query path.
output_format: Print the retrieved value (as a primitive or JSON string), or UNDEFINED if not found.
